d:
Janmashtami is all about tradition, celebration and the flavours we’ve grown up loving!
And since the new generation is always looking for something new to try, this Janmashtami, Chef Sanjeev Kapoor gives a traditional favourite a fun new look with the Khandvi Croissant!
Inspired by the exciting food trends taking over social media, this recipe takes the classic Gujarati khandvi and gives it a playful, contemporary twist — shaping it like a croissant! The flavours you know and love, presented in a completely new way.
